import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strong candidates based on t-statistics
    t_stats = [abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)], 
                                  feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)])[0]) 
               for fid in feats.ids]
    
    # Select top features by t-statistic
    top_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:20]
    top_ids = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated with |r| >= 0.6)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(top_ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_ids)):
            fid1, fid2 = top_ids[i], top_ids[j]
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid1)], 
                               feats.x[:, feats.column(fid2)])[0,1]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(fid2)
    
    filtered_ids = [fid for fid in top_ids if fid not in to_remove]
    
    if not filtered_ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Cluster remaining features using cosine similarity
    X_cluster = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in filtered_ids]]
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=min(3, len(filtered_ids)), 
                                         linkage='ward')
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(X_cluster)
    
    # Find the largest cluster
    unique_clusters, counts = np.unique(clusters, return_counts=True)
    main_cluster_id = unique_clusters[np.argmax(counts)]
    
    # Get features in main cluster
    module_features = [filtered_ids[i] for i in range(len(filtered_ids)) 
                       if clusters[i] == main_cluster_id]
    
    if len(module_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Create weighted score from module features
    weights = np.array([t_stats[feats.ids.index(fid)] for fid in module_features])
    weights = weights / np.sum(weights)  # Normalized weights
    
    # Return design with module features and their loadings
    return Design(
        drivers=(module_features[0],) if module_features else (),
        columns=tuple(module_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=dict(zip(module_features, weights))
    )
